title: Wheat field, through the farmhouse door, out the kitchen window
trick: Every clip starts on the last frame of the one before it, so three separate generations play as one continuous shot.
aspect: match_input_image (all three outputs are 1280x704, 24 fps, 121 frames)
chain_rule: first frame of clip N+1 = frame 119 of clip N (zero-based; the clip has frames 0 to 120)
